releaseNotes: Add startup management features including fetching and updating startup variables and Docker images
changelog: Implemented API service methods for retrieving startup configuration and updating startup variables and Docker images.
Created data models for handling startup responses and requests.
Developed a new StartupViewModel to manage startup data and operations.
Added a StartupScreen UI to display and interact with startup settings.
Introduced StartupRules utility for parsing variable rules.
Added unit tests for startup response parsing and rules validation.
Updated navigation and UI components to integrate the new startup features.
